scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays compelling headline, value proposition, and prominent CTA buttons as specified in REQ-1 and REQ-2

steps.description: Mount the HeroSection component with default props for an unauthenticated user
steps.context: Component should render without errors and display all required elements

steps.description: Check that a large, attention-grabbing headline is present that communicates the core value proposition of URL shortening
steps.context: Headline should be semantically correct (h1) and visually prominent

steps.description: Check that a supporting subheadline explains the service briefly
steps.context: Subheadline should complement the headline and provide clarity

steps.description: Check that a primary CTA button ('Get Started' or 'Create Free Account') is prominently displayed
steps.context: Button should use FuturisticButton component and be visually distinct

steps.description: Check that a secondary CTA button ('Log In') is visible for returning users
steps.context: Secondary button should be visible but less prominent than primary

test_cases.expected: Headline, subheadline, 'Get Started' button, and 'Log In' button are all visible

test_cases.input: Check headline element for semantic HTML
test_cases.expected: Headline uses h1 tag with appropriate styling classes
onGetStarted callback is invoked
onLogin callback is invoked
Primary CTA changes to 'Go to Dashboard' and 'Log In' button is hidden

steps.context: Page should integrate with existing routing setup

steps.context: User should be navigated to the registration page (/register)

steps.context: User should be navigated to the login page (/login)

steps.description: Check that Navbar contains links to login and registration
steps.context: Navigation should be accessible from the header

Navbar contains a link that navigates to /login

scenarios.name: Responsive Design

steps.context: Minimum supported mobile width per Success Criteria

steps.description: Render homepage at 768px width and verify layout adaptation
steps.context: Tablet breakpoint per Success Criteria

steps.context: Desktop breakpoint per Success Criteria

steps.action: Verify no horizontal scrolling on mobile

steps.context: Per US-4 Acceptance Criteria

steps.context: Per US-4 Acceptance Criteria for mobile accessibility

test_cases.expected: All content is readable, no horizontal scrollbar appears
Layout adapts to tablet format, feature cards may stack or display in grid
Full desktop layout with optimal spacing and multi-column layouts where appropriate

test_cases.input: Check feature cards layout on mobile

Navigation is accessible via hamburger menu or visible links

scenarios.name: Accessibility Compliance
scenarios.description: Verify the homepage meets WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards as specified in NFR-3 and US-7

steps.description: Navigate through all interactive elements using only Tab key
steps.context: Per US-7: All elements should be reachable via keyboard

steps.description: Check that focus indicators are clearly visible on all focusable elements
steps.context: Per US-7: Focus indicators must be visible

steps.description: Verify all buttons are activatable with Enter key
steps.context: Per US-7: Buttons must work with keyboard

steps.description: Verify proper use of nav, main, section, and footer elements
steps.context: Per Accessibility Considerations in PRD

steps.description: Check that text meets 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text
steps.context: Per WCAG 2.1 AA standards

steps.description: Verify all images and icons have appropriate alt text
steps.context: Per Accessibility Considerations in PRD

test_cases.input: Press Tab key repeatedly starting from page load
test_cases.expected: Focus moves through interactive elements in logical order (hero CTAs, nav, features, footer)

test_cases.input: Tab to CTA button and observe focus styling
test_cases.expected: Focus indicator is clearly visible (outline or ring visible around button)

test_cases.input: Tab to 'Get Started' button and press Enter
test_cases.expected: Button is activated and navigation occurs

test_cases.input: Run axe-core accessibility audit on homepage
test_cases.expected: No critical or serious accessibility violations reported

test_cases.input: Check page structure for semantic elements
test_cases.expected: Page contains <nav>, <main>, <section>, and <footer> elements appropriately
Headings follow proper hierarchy (h1 for main headline, h2 for section titles, etc.)

test_cases.input: Check feature card icons for accessible labels
test_cases.expected: Icons have aria-label or aria-hidden with visible text alternatives

test_cases.input: Test with screen reader (simulated via role queries)
test_cases.expected: All content is accessible and properly announced
